heroHeadline: North Korea Confirms Hypersonic Warhead, Vows to Keep Nuclear Arsenal 'Forever' as Russia Invites Kim to Visit
heroSubtitle: KCNA confirmed on September 22, 2026 that North Korea's September 20 double short-range ballistic missile launch from Wonsan — its 14th weapons test of the year — tested an upgraded hypersonic-glide warhead, with Kim Jong-un calling it an 'incurable headache' for adversaries. Pyongyang also test-fired an upgraded 240mm guided rocket launcher on September 22 aimed at the southern border, and rejected the IAEA's formally adopted 70th General Conference resolution on September 19, with Kim Yo-jong accusing the watchdog of 'double standards.' Foreign Minister Choe Son-hui declared September 24 that North Korea's nuclear status is 'irreversible... and will remain unchanged forever,' responding to US-South Korea-Japan trilateral talks in New York reaffirming denuclearization, the same day Russia's Deputy Foreign Minister said Kim Jong-un has been formally invited to visit Moscow.
footerNote: Data sourced from US/ROK official reports, KCNA, UN panels, IAEA, and institutional analyses. North Korea does not publish national statistics — economic figures are estimates with wide uncertainty ranges.
